main.name: Mario Merino
main.description: In my free time, I love exploring Houston with my son, reading, and volunteering at my church.
main.bio: I am a full stack engineer with over 6 years of experience building scalable, accessible applications using React, TypeScript, Node.js, and cloud platforms like AWS and GCP. I have led distributed teams, mentored developers, and delivered robust solutions in fintech, proptech, and enterprise settings. My focus is on creating high-quality user experiences and collaborating effectively across teams.

work.title: Senior Software Engineer

Automated developer workflows with CI/CD, integrated GitHub–Jira, maintained a component library in Storybook, and mentored junior engineers in a distributed team environment.
